{{Quote|Revan! Lord Malak told us you still lived. At last, a challenge worthy of my skills. I grow so bored with slaughtering these mindless training droids. I intensified my training ten fold in hopes I would get the chance to face you in mortal combat, I'm glad to see my training has not been in vain.|[[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]]|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Sith Lord|Sith]] in [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Darth Revan's Empire]]. When [[Darth Malak]] seized control of the empire, this master swore allegiance to the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. He was in charge of the [[Temple of the Ancients]] on [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], and was responsible for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] education of the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] there. When a redeemed [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] entered the temple along with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jolee Bindo]] and [[Juhani]] to disable [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon's]] [[disruptor field]] in order to destroy the [[Star Forge]], the trio encountered this master, who was eager to face Revan, having greatly intensified his training with the hope that he would have the opportunity to fight and kill [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] combat. However, he was ultimately defeated and slain by the former Dark Lord.
